chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn Sirhan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
That which is prohibited due to lineage is also prohibited due to breast-feeding.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between blood lineage and breast-feeding in determining marriage prohibitions?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the foundational legal maxim that the scope of mahram prohibitions in marriage is identical for consanguinity (nasab) and affinity via breast-feeding (radha'). In Shia jurisprudence, this principle ensures that the specific degrees of prohibition listed in the Quran are fully extended to milk-relatives, treating them as equivalent to blood relatives for the purpose of marital validity.
